noop.alreadyPaid: This PO was already marked paid — nothing changed and no journal was posted. If the earlier mark's payment journal never posted, unmark payment and mark it paid again.

standingPayment.title: A payment journal is standing for a PO that is not marked paid
standingPayment.body: This PO's paid mark was removed, but its reversal journal failed to post, so the payment journal still stands on the ledger: payables are cleared and bank is credited for a PO that now reads unpaid. Marking it paid again does not fix that — post the reversal from here.
standingPayment.needsPermission: Posting this reversal needs the journals:manage permission. Ask a Finance user to do it from this PO's page.
standingPayment.markBlocked: "Mark as paid" is disabled while this payment journal is still standing — marking it paid again only hides the warning above without fixing the ledger. Post the reversal journal from that warning first, then mark it paid.
standingPayment.markBlockedRegister: "Mark paid" is disabled: a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing on the ledger even though this PO reads unpaid. Open this PO's detail page, post the reversal journal from the warning there, then mark it paid again.
standingPayment.markRefused: The paid mark was not saved: a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing on the ledger even though this PO reads unpaid. Nothing was written — the payment status, the journals and this PO's history are all unchanged. Post the reversal journal from the standing-payment warning on this page first, then mark it paid again.
standingPayment.markRefusedRegister: The paid mark was not saved: a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing on the ledger even though this PO reads unpaid. Nothing was written — the payment status, the journals and this PO's history are all unchanged. Open this PO's detail page, post the reversal journal from the warning there, then mark it paid again.
standingPayment.posted: Reversal journal posted. The ledger now matches this PO's unpaid status.
standingPayment.errForbidden: You do not have the journals:manage permission needed to post this reversal.
standingPayment.errBadState: This PO is no longer in that state — either the reversal has been posted or the PO was marked paid again. The page has been reloaded.
standingPayment.errFailed: The reversal journal could not be posted ({code}). Check the account mapping and this PO's journals in Finance, then try again.

err.GRN_APPROVAL_PENDING: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. One of this PO's receipts is still awaiting the owner's decision. Have the owner approve or decline it first, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.GRN_JOURNALS_INCOMPLETE: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. One of this PO's receipts has no GRN journal. Post the missing GRN journal from its GRN row, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.GRN_REVERSAL_MISSING: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. A receipt was declined by the owner and its GRN journal was never reversed. Post the reversal journal from the declined GRN's row, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.AP_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. The receipts booked their payable to a different account than the AP posting role now resolves to. Check the AP account mapping in Account Mapping, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.PAYMENT_SUPERSEDED: The payment status was saved, but a payment journal from an earlier mark is still standing for a different amount than this PO now owes, so no new journal was posted. Payables and bank are NOT untouched here — they still hold that earlier payment, which no longer clears this PO's payable. Unmark payment, confirm in Finance that the reversal journal actually posted this time, then mark it paid again. If that reversal fails too, this PO raises a standing-payment warning with a button that posts the reversal directly.
err.UNMAPPED_ROLE: The payment status was saved, but no payment journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. The posting role "{role}" is not mapped to an account. Map it in Account Mapping, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
err.NOTHING_TO_POST: The PO was marked paid, but no payable was found booked to the GL for it, so no journal was posted — payables and bank are both untouched. Confirm this PO should be marked paid at all; if a receipt is missing, receive it first, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.

UNBALANCED.payment: The payment status was saved, but the payment journal was unbalanced (debit ≠ credit) so it was not posted — payables and bank are both untouched. Check this PO's journals in Finance, then unmark payment and mark it paid again.
UNBALANCED.reversal: The paid mark was removed, but its reversal journal was unbalanced (debit ≠ credit) so it was not posted. Payables and bank are NOT untouched here — the earlier payment journal is still standing, so payables are cleared and bank is credited for a PO that now reads unpaid. This PO shows a standing-payment warning; post the reversal from the button on that warning.

GENERIC.payment: The payment status was saved, but the payment journal failed to post because of an unexpected error. Check this PO's journals and the account mapping in Finance; if the payment journal really is missing, unmark payment and mark it paid again.
GENERIC.reversal: The paid mark was removed, but its reversal journal failed to post because of an unexpected error, so the earlier payment journal is most likely still standing — payables cleared and bank credited for a PO that now reads unpaid. Check this PO's journals in Finance; if the standing-payment warning is shown on this PO, post the reversal from the button on it.

COMPOUND.name: Compound

cashFlow.unclassifiedBody: {count} accounts have not been assigned to operating, investing, or financing activities, so they are shown separately. Totals remain correct.
cashFlow.reconciledNote: The computed change in cash equals the actual movement in cash balances. Every journal is validated as balanced when posted, so this agreement is expected — this check only detects corrupt data.
cashFlow.unreconciledNote: The computed change in cash does NOT equal the actual movement in cash balances. This indicates corrupt journal data — check the general ledger.
cashFlow.coverageBody: This report is built from general-ledger journals using the indirect method. Its coverage matches the income statement: it does NOT yet include field sales (putus/konsi) or SPG sales.

receivables.emptyBody: A receivable appears on its own once a billing note is issued from a putus delivery, or can be brought in by Excel import for sales made outside Elorae.
receivables.reasonKlaim: You reported a transfer via {no}. Finance has not seen the money land yet, so it does not count as settled.
receivables.reasonTertahan: Held by return {nilai} — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received. The balance cannot reach zero until the shortfall is settled.
receivables.reasonLewat: The shop promised {tgl} — {hari} days past and no money has arrived. Chase it and get a new date.
receivables.reasonTt: Handed over ({no}). The shop promised {tgl} — wait for the date.
receivables.reasonBelum: Ready to hand over — no return hanging and nothing overdue.

payments.pageDescription: Transfer claims reported by sales. A receivable only drops once finance matches it against the bank statement.
payments.rejectBody: Sales reads the reason on their phone. Say what is wrong and what they should do — without it they will chase the same place again.
payments.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. money has not landed as of today, ask the shop to resend the transfer proof
payments.emptyBody: Claims appear here once sales reports from the field that a shop has transferred.
payments.okVerified: Claim verified — the receivable has been recomputed.
payments.okRejected: Claim rejected. Sales will see the reason.
payments.errTANPA_AKSES: Only finance may decide a claim.
payments.errTIDAK_DITEMUKAN: Claim not found — it may have been deleted.
payments.errSUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: This claim was already decided. Reload the page.
payments.errGAGAL: Could not save the decision. Try again.
payments.newBody: A report that the shop has transferred. This does NOT reduce the receivable — finance matches it against the bank statement.
payments.sectionInvoicesHint: Tick the invoices, then enter how much if it is not the full amount.
payments.sectionDeductionsHint: A deduction that comes from a return must be linked to its return note — that link is what holds the amount until the warehouse finishes counting.
payments.proofHint: Match the figure in the transfer photo against the bank statement before verifying.
payments.noOpenInvoices: This shop has no open invoices.
payments.deductionReturnHint: A deduction linked to a return note is held in full until the warehouse counts, then only the shortfall is held until somebody bears it.
payments.transferPhotoHint: Required. This is what finance matches against the bank statement.
payments.breakdownPhotoHint: Optional. The shop's own working sheet, if there is one.
payments.negativeReceived: Deductions exceed the invoice value. Check the figures.
payments.claimNotSettled: Until this is verified, the receivable does not drop by a single rupiah.
payments.heldExplain: Verified, but {value} is not recognised — the return deduction does not match what the warehouse received.
payments.okClaimCreated: {doc} sent. Waiting for finance to verify.
payments.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The transfer date could not be read.
payments.errTANPA_PIUTANG: Pick the invoices being settled first.
payments.errPIUTANG_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: One of the invoices no longer exists. Reload this page.
payments.errBEDA_TOKO: One claim covers one shop only.
payments.errSUDAH_LUNAS: One of the invoices turns out to be settled. Reload this page.
payments.errMELEBIHI_SISA: One invoice is being settled for more than it has outstanding.
payments.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: One of the figures is not valid.
payments.errRETUR_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN: The chosen return note no longer exists.
payments.errRETUR_BEDA_TOKO: That return note belongs to a different shop.
payments.errFOTO_WAJIB: The transfer receipt photo is required.
payments.errNOMOR_BENTROK: The claim number clashed. Try sending again.
payments.errJENIS_BUTUH_RETUR: A deduction of this type must be linked to a return note.
payments.errJENIS_HANYA_PKP: This deduction is for PKP stores only. Mark the store as PKP first if that is correct.
payments.errJENIS_BUTUH_CATATAN: A deduction of this type must have an explanation.
payments.voidBody: For a claim that was ENTERED WRONG — wrong invoice, wrong amount, wrong return link. Different from rejecting, which means the money genuinely was not in the account. The row is kept, and the receivable is recomputed.
payments.voidPlaceholder: e.g. wrong invoice picked, re-entered on another claim
payments.why_DIBATALKAN: This report was voided because it was entered wrong, not because the money was missing.
payments.relinkBody: Change which return note the deduction “{nama}” points at, or unlink it. This changes how much is held, so the receivable is recomputed.
payments.danglingRow: the return note it points at no longer exists
payments.danglingWarning: A deduction points at a return note that no longer exists. Its value is held in full against the receivable — the safe direction — but it will never be released until the link is corrected with “Re-link”.

collections.finishBlocked: Some invoices on this note are still unpaid.
collections.cancelBody: The invoices become free again and can go onto another note. Write down why, so it does not become an argument later.
collections.cancelPlaceholder: For example: invoices taken back, shop refused to sign
collections.createBody: Pick the shop, then which invoices were handed over. A collection note does not reduce the receivable — it only records that the shop is holding the invoice.
collections.receivedByPlaceholder: Name of the person at the shop who signed
collections.emptyBody: A collection note is created when physical invoices are handed to a shop.

storeReturns.pageDescription: One list for every return. Each row names the next step and whose turn it is.
storeReturns.summary: {count} to work on · {held} held back from receivables
storeReturns.flow1Body: Number and contents copied from the shop's own note. The number is theirs, not ours.
storeReturns.flow2Body: Counts what actually arrived. Until it is counted, the return deduction is not recognised at all.
storeReturns.flow3Body: If less arrived than the shop claimed, decide who bears it. Until then the invoice stays open.
storeReturns.effectKeputusan: the difference holds the invoice open
storeReturns.effectCek: the return deduction is not recognised
storeReturns.effectJodoh: goods arrived with no shop note
storeReturns.whyKeputusan: The warehouse received less than the shop claimed. That difference holds the invoice open until somebody is named to bear it.
storeReturns.whyCek: The goods are not recorded as received. While that is empty, the return deduction on the payment claim counts for nothing.
storeReturns.whyJodoh: Goods arrived with no shop note. They must be matched to one before anything can be compared.
storeReturns.whyBeres: Claim and physical agree, or the difference has been assigned.
storeReturns.whyBatal: The note was withdrawn. Deductions already pointing at it stay held in full.
storeReturns.noNrtHint: Copy it exactly from the shop's note. This is the number you will look for in the archive.
storeReturns.createBody: What the shop says it returned. Until the warehouse counts, the whole amount is held back from the receivable — a return is recognised at the physical amount, not the claimed one.
storeReturns.countBody: {doc} — the shop claims {claimed}. Enter the value of what actually arrived.
storeReturns.receiveOrphanTitle: Receive goods with no shop note
storeReturns.receiveOrphanBody: The goods arrived ahead of the note. Record it now, match it once the note turns up.
storeReturns.countHint: Zero is valid and means nothing arrived. That is different from not yet counted, and it can only be recorded once.
storeReturns.pairBody: {doc}, worth {value}. Pick the shop note it belongs to.
storeReturns.pairNoCandidates: No shop note is waiting for a warehouse count.
storeReturns.compareTitle: Shop's claim against the warehouse count
storeReturns.compareHint: Red figures are goods that did not arrive as claimed.
storeReturns.noPhoto: No photo of the note yet. The photo is what the archive is made of.
storeReturns.warehousePending: The warehouse has not counted. While that is empty, the return deduction counts for nothing.
storeReturns.perItemHint: An item that did not arrive at all appears only on the claim side.
storeReturns.chargeOpenBody: The shop took {claimed} off the payment; the warehouse received {counted}. Until this is decided the invoice stays open and the salesman sees a “return held” flag.
storeReturns.chargeCompanyHint: “The company bears it” means the money is written off — pick it only when there is genuinely nobody to charge.
storeReturns.assignBody: The {gap} difference will be borne by {who}. This releases the invoice; recovering it runs on its own.
storeReturns.assignPlaceholder: e.g. deduct from next month's commission
storeReturns.markSettledHint: Does not change the receivable — the invoice was released when the difference was assigned.
storeReturns.usedInClaims: Used as a deduction on payment claims
storeReturns.usedInClaimsEmpty: This note has not been used to reduce any payment yet, so it is holding nothing.
storeReturns.cancelBody: Deductions already pointing at this note do NOT disappear — if the shop has already taken it off a payment, that money is still short and still owed. A cancelled note reads as zero physical, so its deductions are held in full until somebody corrects them.
storeReturns.emptyBody: Every return is settled, or no note has been recorded yet.
storeReturns.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to this action.
storeReturns.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
storeReturns.errNOMOR_SUDAH_DIPAKAI: That note number is already used for this shop.
storeReturns.errSUDAH_DIHITUNG: This note already has a warehouse count. Unmatch it first if the count is wrong.
storeReturns.errBUKAN_YATIM: This receipt already has a match.
storeReturns.errBEDA_TOKO: This receipt is recorded against a different shop.
storeReturns.errTIDAK_ADA_SELISIH: There is no difference to assign.
storeReturns.errSUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: The difference has already been assigned.
storeReturns.errBEBAN_SUDAH_DIPUTUSKAN: The difference has been assigned — it can no longer be unmatched or cancelled.
storeReturns.errBELUM_DIPUTUSKAN: The difference has not been assigned yet.
storeReturns.errSUDAH_LUNAS: This charge is already marked paid back.
storeReturns.errNOMOR_BENTROK: The number clashed with one just created. Try saving again.
storeReturns.itemsHint: May be left empty when only the total was recorded. Without detail all you see later is THAT there is a shortfall — not which item is short.
storeReturns.stockHint: Items picked from the catalogue will ADD to warehouse stock when this count is saved. Rows with only a typed name do not move stock.
storeReturns.photoHint: Required. These photos are what the archive is made of — a note without one leaves only a figure you cannot show the shop.
storeReturns.bearerPersonHint: A charge attaches to a person, not a role — that is what makes it appear on their screen and deductible from their commission.

konsinyasi.pageDescription: One cycle = one shop × one month. Each row names its stage and whose turn it is.
konsinyasi.summary: {count} cycles · {late} SPG salaries past their date
konsinyasi.lateWarning: {count} cycles have an SPG salary past its date. This is the one that gets forgotten.
konsinyasi.why_laporan: One of the two reports has not arrived. With only one there is nothing to compare.
konsinyasi.why_cocok: Both reports are in but the figures are not locked. There is no official number yet.
konsinyasi.why_bayar_spg: Figures are locked; the SPG commission has not been paid.
konsinyasi.why_nota: Salary settled. The sales admin has not issued a nota.
konsinyasi.why_pajak: The nota exists. The tax admin has not recorded the tax invoice number.
konsinyasi.why_selesai: Chain complete — all three numbers present.
konsinyasi.emptyBody: Open a cycle for a consignment shop for the month you want to reconcile.
konsinyasi.spgDueHint: Its own date, separate from every other deadline — so the SPG salary stops losing to noisier work.
konsinyasi.openCycleBody: One cycle per shop per month. Every report, the official figures, and all three document numbers hang off it.
konsinyasi.shipBody: Goods sent to a consignment shop. Consigned stock is shipped minus sold.
konsinyasi.threeNumbersHint: They may be entirely unrelated. Side by side here so nobody has to ask which nota number it was.
konsinyasi.compareHint: The SPG reports by email, the shop by carrier. Red rows differ, or appear in only one report.
konsinyasi.reportBody: Copy it as it stands. Corrections happen when the figures are locked, not here.
konsinyasi.lockBody: These figures — not either raw report — bill the shop, pay the commission and reduce consigned stock. Prefilled from the SPG report; correct what needs correcting.
konsinyasi.baseSalaryHint: Base salary is whole for each; only the commission is split.
konsinyasi.commissionFromMaster: The per-piece commission rate is taken from the item master at lock time and copied onto the official line — changing the rate next month does not change this month's commission.
konsinyasi.openCharge: Still owes {value} in return charges — consider netting it off this commission.
konsinyasi.stockHint: Shipped minus sold. Derived, not stored.
konsinyasi.stockEmpty: Nothing has been shipped to this shop yet.
konsinyasi.recordNotaBody: The sales admin's number. It may be entirely unrelated to ours.
konsinyasi.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to this action.
konsinyasi.errTANGGAL_TIDAK_VALID: The date could not be read.
konsinyasi.errTOKO_BUKAN_KONSI: That shop is not a consignment shop.
konsinyasi.errSIKLUS_SUDAH_ADA: A cycle for that shop and month already exists.
konsinyasi.errPERIODE_TIDAK_VALID: That month or year is not valid.
konsinyasi.errSUDAH_DIKUNCI: The figures are locked. Unlock them first.
konsinyasi.errBELUM_DIKUNCI: The figures are not locked yet.
konsinyasi.errLAPORAN_BELUM_LENGKAP: Both reports must arrive first — locking on one means locking a figure that was never compared to anything.
konsinyasi.errADA_GAJI_SUDAH_DIBAYAR: A salary has already been paid. Unlocking after that means the commission could be recomputed smaller than what is already in someone's pocket.
konsinyasi.errNILAI_TIDAK_VALID: One of the figures is not valid.
konsinyasi.errSUDAH_DIBAYAR: This salary is already marked paid.

jenisPotongan.pageDescription: The deductions allowed on a payment claim, and the rules attached to each.
jenisPotongan.methodHint_PERSEN: The amount is a percentage of the invoice.
jenisPotongan.methodHint_DARI_RETUR: MUST be linked to a return note. That link is what holds the amount until the warehouse finishes counting — without this type, linking depends entirely on whoever is typing remembering to.
jenisPotongan.ruleNoteHint: A deduction of this type cannot be saved without an explanation.
jenisPotongan.rulePkpHint: A marker only — Elorae has no taxable flag on a shop, so nothing enforces it yet.
jenisPotongan.ruleManualHint: When off, this type may only arrive from another process, not be typed by an admin.
jenisPotongan.ruleActiveHint: Inactive types do not appear when creating a claim, but stay attached to older ones.
jenisPotongan.formBody: The rules chosen here are enforced when a claim is saved, not merely displayed.
jenisPotongan.emptyBody: While the list is empty, deduction names are typed freehand on every claim.
jenisPotongan.explain: Types are NOT deleted, only disabled. One that has been used stays attached to older claims, and deleting it would strip the name off historical deductions — old reports would change after being closed.
jenisPotongan.errTANPA_AKSES: You do not have access to change deduction types.
jenisPotongan.errNAMA_SUDAH_ADA: That name is already used by another type.
